title: The quest 'The Old Kings' Hounds' ('the lodge hall's own roll might say more') never actually paid off through the lodge hall: reading the roll there ('read the roll's cadence') only resolved the separate 'Recall's Three Notes' quest and said nothing about hounds or a barrow. The Old Kings' Hounds quest was only resolved by stumbling into 'the Hound-Graves' through unguided riding exploration well south of the hinted location, with the quest's hint text never updating to point there.
where: The Hunt's Stand — Lodge Hall / the Hound-Graves
